'''GL-0T15''' was a [[Color|black]]-plated<ref name="SoloOG" /> [[GL vendor droid]]<ref name="Kids" /> owned by the criminal syndicate [[Crimson Dawn]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. It served as the operator for the principal [[turbolift]] onboard the ''[[First Light]]'', the personal [[Nau'ur-class yacht|yacht]] of Crimson Dawn's [[Crime lord|leader]] [[Dryden Vos]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Vandor]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[10 BBY]].</ref> the [[Shopkeeper droid|vendor droid]] spent [[time]] on the [[yacht]]'s viewing platform amongst the guests of a party that Vos was hosting and was present in the room when the criminal [[Tobias Beckett]] and his [[Beckett's gang|associates]] [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] arrived.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> GL-0T15 was equipped with a bank of weapon [[scanner]]s, including close-range [[sensor]] modules in its head that could detect chemical and energy weaponry.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
GL-0T15 first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
